new:
"""`cents` as text: `12.50`, `(0.05)`, `1,234.00`: negatives in
    parentheses, as statements print them."""
    whole, frac = divmod(abs(cents), 100)
    text = f"{whole:,}.{frac:02d}"
    return f"({text})" if cents < 0 else text
